title: Aliens
build: US Activision disk, 'Aliens [Activision].d64', a cracked copy: a Remember cracktro and trainer (22 KB BASIC file at $0801) in front of ten packed game files A0-A9

Sprite frames $10-$1F.
Sprite frames $20-$23.
The fight's entry points: start ($8000) and restart ($8002), both fight_init. The object table addresses after them are all $8028 too: the fight uses no engine objects.

Starts the fight: interrupts off, a black border, the bitmap off, the raster call to raster_top ($8270), and the VIC-II set from the list after the call.

Text to the bitmap at $6000; page 6, the screen, the colours and the bitmap cleared. The loader's arms at heights $38 and 0, the Queen at x $50, y $50, the loader at x $5C; the speeds $0495-$0499; then the picture unpacked (unpack_fight), VIC-II bank 1, the sprites' colours (the loader yellow, the Queen black) and multicolours, the screen on, sfx_alarm twice.
Inside the STA $0600 above (the right arm's height): the low byte of its operand. Nothing reads it as an address.
start_effect's argument: $3582, sfx_alarm, the first of the two alarms as the fight opens.
32 frames later, the second alarm.
start_effect's argument: $3582, sfx_alarm again.
48 frames more, then the fight begins.

Once a frame: now and then a new random number for the Queen's head ($0623). The Queen wins if she reaches the bottom (y $74 or more) at her full speed ($0497 = $27): sfx_alarm, and the level is lost ($0203 = 0). Otherwise the grip (grip_tick), and, when the airlock has taken her ($0622 bit 7), the ending; else the state's handler from fight_states.
Named by the trainer of level 6, which writes a JMP $814F here when that level is loaded, so the Queen never wins by reaching the bottom.
The low byte of the JSR's operand; level 6's trainer writes $4F here (JMP $814F).
The high byte; level 6's trainer writes $81 here.
start_effect's argument: $3582, sfx_alarm, as the Queen reaches the bottom and wins.
192 frames' wait, then the bitmap off, the level lost ($0203 = 0) and the engine's stage_complete.
The fight goes on: the grip, then the ending if the airlock has her.
The state $0611 picks the handler, written into the JMP at $816B.
The handler's address, low byte (written here).
The handler's high byte.
The three states' handlers: 0 the fight ($8183), 1 the Queen thrown back right ($8174), 2 thrown back left ($817A).
The same table from its second byte: fight_states,x is a handler's low byte, this its high byte.
State 1's handler, thrown_right ($8174).
State 2's handler, thrown_left ($817A).
State 1: the Queen reels right (queen_reel_right) and up (queen_rise).
Named by the trainer of level 4, which pokes here when that level is loaded; in this fight the JMP's operand.
State 2: the Queen reels left (queen_reel_left) and up (queen_rise).

State 0. The loader's speed across ($0496) builds from $10 to $40 while left or right is held. The speeds advance (add_score_digits, used here as a fraction adder: each speed in $0495-$0499 adds into $049F-$04A3, whose whole steps move things), then the claws, the arms, the Queen, the swing of her tail, and the loader's hum.

Not while she is held: an arm high enough to reach her (her y less its height at least $4C) and across from her, pushed towards her, strikes her (strike). Then with a smaller gap ($52): a claw at her (claw_reach) with the arm under her takes hold of her ($0619 bit 7).
Three NOPs.
Any joystick movement starts sfx_siren, the loader's hum, when it changes; none silences it.
start_effect's argument: $3678 (sfx_siren).
The hum already playing: nothing to do.
At random: nothing (two in eight), sfx_alarm, her shriek (three), or sfx_engine (three).
start_effect's argument: $3582, sfx_alarm, one of her cries.
Back to the fight.
start_effect's argument: $38A4 (sfx_engine).
A quiet turn: no cry.
The sprite frames of her tail ($0D-$12), by step.
The frames of her body sprite (sprite 5), $07-$0C, by step.
The steps her tail and legs swing through, 48 of them, back and forth.

The raster call at line 5: sprite pointers and places for the loader (sprites 0-3: its claws, frame $0603 and $0603+$1C, at the arms' heights) and the Queen (sprites 4-7: head, frames $05/$06 or $20/$21 at random, body, tail and legs), all sprites on, and the next call just above her lower half.
Reuses sprites 5 and 6 for the Queen's lower half, the legs' frame from $0609; the next call at line $DC.

At line $DF all sprite pointers to frame 4 (blank); while she reels (state not 0) the screen shakes, the fine scrolls one line and pixel off on odd frames; at line $F0 level_frame, and back to raster_top at line 5.
Inside raster_floor: the trainer pokes $839C when it loads level 1, whose own code lies here then.
Named by the trainer of level 1, which lies here when that level is loaded; in this fight raster_floor's LDA $0208.
Inside raster_floor: the trainer pokes $839E when it loads level 1, whose own code lies here then.
The ways she picks at random: right and down, left and down, or down.
The Queen, unless held: her limits (queen_limits), then a step each way in $060B by her speeds ($04A1 across, $04A3 up); then her lower half (lower_step).
Her step right.
Her step left.
Her step up.
Her step down.
Fire closes the loader's claws a step every four frames, to 2 (to 1 while she is held); releasing opens them.

While she is held, after a short wait ($061B): with the airlock open ($0621), letting go of fire drops her into it if she is over it (x $30-$7F): sfx_alarm, she falls (queen_fall) and the airlock has taken her ($0622 = $80). Let go elsewhere, the airlock closes (airlock_close) and she breaks free. Holding fire with it closed opens it (airlock_open); letting go then, she breaks free.
start_effect's argument: $3582, sfx_alarm, as she drops into the airlock.
Her fall, the claws open, and the airlock has taken her ($0622 = $80).
She breaks free: no hold, the state to 1 (thrown back), and a cry.
She drops three lines a frame until y $83, then goes off to x $D0.
Waits 8 frames.
The airlock opens: its half-open picture, 8 frames, then the open one.
The airlock closes: its half-open picture, then the whole fight picture again, and the speed bar redrawn (speed_bar).

Up raises the right arm and lowers the left (two lines at most from the top, $2A at the bottom); down the reverse; while she is held by an arm, she moves with it. Right and left move the loader ($2C-$90), and her with it while held.
Steps her lower half's frame (lower_frames) by $04A2 a pass, forwards when she moves right or down, backwards otherwise.
The frames of her lower half ($13-$16), which raster_queen shows.
Every eight frames the swing steps of tail and legs move on (to 48 and round).

Keeps her in the room: not over the loader's arms, back from the sides (x $20-$C0, turning at $88), not too high (down below y $38) and not lower than y $74 (where she waits longer, $2F passes). When her count $060C runs out she picks a new way (queen_ways) for 31 to 62 passes.
Whether the right arm is under her by at least the gap $0612 ($0614 bit 7).
The same for the left arm ($0613).
Whether she is across from the loader's right arm ($0616).
Whether she is across from its left arm ($0615).
Her span across, for the two tests above.
Whether a claw is at her: the right one within 9 to the right of x+$18 ($0617), the left within 9 of x-$3D ($0618); not with the claws shut. Sets the grip's wait $061B.
Inside claw_reach: the trainer pokes $8798 when it loads level 5, whose own code lies here then.
While she reels she rises four lines every two frames; above y $30 she comes back to fight (state 0).
Reeling right: four across every two frames, the loader pushed one back; at x $90 she turns to reel left.
Reeling left; once x is below $10 she turns to reel right.
Named by the trainer of level 3, which writes an LDA here when that level is loaded; in this fight queen_reel_left's CMP #$10.
The four position tests: across_left, across_right, under_left, under_right.
Pushing right or left as an arm meets her strikes her: she slows (queen_hurt), cries out and reels that way (state 1 or 2).
Inside strike: the trainer pokes $8854 when it loads level 3, whose own code lies here then.
Takes one from her speeds across ($0497) and up ($0499), unless already 0, and sets when she starts to recover: two ticks of $020B, three when she is slow.
When the time comes she recovers one point of speed (to $27 at most), and again a tick later.
Named by the trainer of level 6, which writes $AD here (LDA), so she never recovers.
Named by the trainer of level 6, a second $AD: her speed up never recovers either.
Named by the trainer of level 6, a third $AD: her next recovery is never set.
Three NOPs, then speed_bar.
The bar along the bottom (colour RAM $DBA2-$DBB5, 20 cells): red for her speed above $11, green for the rest.

The airlock has taken her: tune2 and a wait. A player who skipped a stage ($0202 set by stage_abort) sees no more: the game waits for RETURN and starts again. Otherwise the picture at $E000 (Bishop's "Not bad... for a human!"), the text of ending_text in white on grey, and the last picture ("The End", from $AB36); then the wait for RETURN.
start_music's argument: $345A (tune2).
A wait of $43 ticks; a player who skipped a stage goes straight to the RETURN wait ($8A4B).
vic_inline_writes's list, register and value: $D016=$08; $FF ends it.
Bitmap cleared, the screen filled with colour $BB, ending_text printed, the screen on, and a wait of $66 ticks.
vic_inline_writes's list: $D016=$18, multicolour on for the last picture; $FF ends it.
The last picture unpacked and shown, then the RETURN wait.

The ending's text for print: "As Newt is being tucked into the hypersleep capsule for the journey home, she grasps Ripley's hand." and their last lines ("Can we dream?" "Yes, honey. I think we both can.").
Three NOPs, then JMP $3B44 in the engine: the wait for RETURN that ends in stage_abort and a new game.
The raster call during the ending: frame_tick only.
The unreached routine's start: a wait of $28 ticks.
tune2 started, and $057B cleared.
The raster call to raster_ending, the sprites off, the screen off.
vic_inline_writes's list for the ending: sprites off ($D015=$00), the raster call at line $FA ($D012); $FF ends it.
Collisions latched, the screen off, interrupts on.
Waits A ticks of the clock $0209.
Named by the trainer of level 2, which pokes here when that level is loaded; in this fight wait_ticks's CMP $0209.
Unpacks the last picture (end_picture).

The last picture's packed length, $1300 (4,864 bytes), then the RTS.
Back from unpack_end.

unpack_inline's arguments: the packed data at $8AB7 (fight_picture).
The fight picture's packed length, $188E (6,286 bytes), then the RTS.
